items.prompt: Implement Python batches(values, size). Return a list of lists with consecutive chunks of at most size items. Preserve order, keep the last partial chunk, and do not mutate the input list. Reject a nonpositive size with ValueError, even when the list is empty. Return only Python code.
required: Preserves order and includes the partial chunk without mutating input.
Rejects nonpositive sizes before chunking.
automatic_failure: Drops the final partial chunk, changes the input, or accepts size zero.

items.prompt: Implement Python first_positions(labels), returning a dict from each string in the list to the index of its first occurrence. Preserve original casing, accept empty strings, and do not modify labels. Return only Python code.
required: Maps distinct strings to their zero-based first index without changing casing or input.
Supports empty labels and an empty list.
automatic_failure: Uses last occurrences or normalizes casing.

required: States Wednesday at 11 a.m. in B214 and calls the guest list a draft.
Requests caption confirmation and uses a greeting and sign-off in 45–85 words.

Asks about next Monday delivery and requests tracking in a neutral 45–85 word email.
automatic_failure: Claims the replacement date or tracking is confirmed.

items.prompt: Write Python moving_totals(values, width) for a list of integers. Return a list of each full consecutive window sum, left to right. Reject width <= 0 with ValueError. Return [] when width exceeds the list length. Do not mutate values. Use linear time and return only code.
required: Returns the right ordered full-window sums with no mutation and linear work.
Handles invalid and oversized width.
automatic_failure: Uses repeated width-sized summation, includes partial windows, or accepts width zero.

items.prompt: Write Python invert_groups(groups), where groups is a dictionary from string labels to lists of member names. Return a dictionary from member name to a list of its groups in input dictionary order. List each group once per member even when a name repeats within it. Do not mutate the input. Return only code.
required: Preserves group order for each member and deduplicates repeated membership within a group.
Leaves the input unchanged and handles empty groups.
automatic_failure: Sorts groups, repeats memberships, or mutates input.

items.prompt: Write Python runs(text) returning a list of (character, count) tuples for each maximal run of the same character in a string. Keep case and whitespace exact. Return [] for empty text. Return only code.
required: Returns tuples for contiguous runs in order, preserving case and spaces.
Handles empty and single-character strings.
automatic_failure: Counts total occurrences instead of contiguous runs or drops whitespace.

items.prompt: Write Python apply_changes(stock, changes). Copy the dictionary stock, apply ordered (name, integer delta) pairs, and return that dictionary. Missing names start at zero. Keep entries that end at zero. If a change would make any quantity negative, raise ValueError immediately. Leave stock unchanged even on failure. Return only code.
required: Copies stock, applies changes in order, and keeps zero quantities.
Rejects an intermediate negative quantity and leaves the input unchanged.
automatic_failure: Mutates the input or waits until the end to reject a negative quantity.

items.prompt: In 55–100 words, write a customer support email from Eli to Jo. A library pass renewal failed because the address is incomplete. Ask only for street number and postcode.
